annotations.title: Check PCB layout for blocking issues

description: Checks a saved PCB layout at expectedRevision for manufacturing or layout review. Its geometry and applied electrical requirements must both be current. A missing or stale layout requires generate_layout and completion first; electrical_requirements_not_applied also requires regeneration before checking or manufacturing export. Reuses a current assessment or computes and saves one, which requires write access and normal compute capacity. If the board changes during the check, read get_board again. Returns hasBlockingIssues and actionable blockingIssues; no numeric score or deductions.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

expectedRevision.description: Latest saved revision from create_board, update_board or get_board. Reuse it if no intervening change is known. A mismatch returns revision_conflict; read the board again before preparing a new operation.
